sources.title: USPP8205P — PSI-.118: historical strawberry trial and original claim
sources.enumerated_scope: All 8 original PDF pages, including four drawing sheets. One filing-subject name; parents/comparators accounted separately. Google citation and similar-document lists are outside this original-document scope.
sources.limitations: Historical strawberry selection: the original patent describes a November 1987 trial on a Watsonville ranch provided by Well-Pict. It names a joint Plant Sciences / Coast Cooling breeding program. This is a trial-site connection, not proof that Well-Pict bred, owns or currently sells this variety. The title uses PSI-.118; body text uses PSI-118 and 118, while photographic labels use 86.118. Those spelling/code variants require identity review; no alias is approved. Bounded historical document only; current legal status, owner, expiry, commercial availability and growing footprint remain unverified. Historical yield/trait comparisons are not approved profile values. Three photographic sheets have unknown reuse; the fourth sheet is an isozyme diagram, not a fruit photograph.
